from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-f58be651.py'
program_source = '''def transform(grid):
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    scores = {}
    for color in colors:
        top = sum(v == color for row in grid[:split] for v in row)
        bottom = sum(v == color for row in grid[split + 1:] for v in row)
        scores[color] = abs(bottom - top)
    color = max(colors, key=lambda c: scores[c])
    return [[color, color], [color, color]]
'''
program_path.write_text(program_source)
print(program_path, program_path.exists(), program_path.read_text())
